levels.title: Foundation
levels.description: Build the core of English: basic grammar, essential vocabulary, and simple communication for everyday situations.

levels.title: Consolidation
levels.description: Expand basic structures and begin producing language with greater independence.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.description: Handle most everyday situations and express opinions on familiar topics.

levels.title: Upper Intermediate
levels.description: Interact with fluency, understand main ideas of complex texts, and produce clear detailed writing.
